project: Shadow Nursery – Horror Short (Peter-Pan-inspiriert, Public Domain J. M. Barrie)
rights_note: Nur Barrie-Original nutzen. KEIN Disney-Look: kein grünes Outfit, kein Federhut, keine Tinker-Bell-Optik.
style_suffix: same girl, same nursery, live-action horror film, cinematic 35mm, film grain, desaturated cold blue tones, realistic, 16:9

characters.girl: girl around 10, brown hair, white Edwardian nightgown
characters.boy: small boy around 6, blond messy hair, white nightshirt
characters.shadow: tall thin shadow of a boy, unnaturally long fingers, no visible body

clips.title: Das Haus
clips.prompt: Slow drone push-in towards an old Victorian townhouse in foggy London, 1900s, one upstairs window glowing faintly, wet cobblestones, cold moonlight, eerie silence
clips.sound: wind, distant church bell, low drone

clips.title: Kinderzimmer
clips.prompt: Interior of a dim Edwardian nursery at night, three small wooden beds, the girl sleeping, the window slowly creaks open by itself, thin curtains billowing, candle flickers, slow dolly shot

clips.title: Der Schatten
clips.prompt: Close-up of nursery wallpaper, the tall thin shadow appears on the wall although nobody is in the room, it tilts its head unnaturally, long fingers, subtle camera shake
clips.sound: silence, then a faint child's giggle

clips.title: Das Flüstern
clips.prompt: The shadow crawls slowly across the wall and ceiling towards the boy's bed, the boy half asleep opens his eyes, the shadow leans over him whispering, cold breath visible, low angle shot
clips.sound: whisper: 'Do you want to never grow up?'

clips.title: Das Nicken
clips.prompt: Extreme close-up of the boy's pale face in moonlight, a dark shadowy hand gently touches his cheek, he slowly nods half asleep, tears in his eyes, shallow depth of field

clips.title: Das Verschwinden
clips.prompt: Wide shot of the nursery, the boy is pulled silently upwards out of his bed by the shadow and drifts out of the open window into the foggy night sky, curtains violently flapping, candle blows out

clips.title: Der Morgen
clips.prompt: Grey cold morning light in the nursery, the girl wakes up and looks at the empty bed, messy sheets, a few black feathers on the windowsill, slow push-in on her terrified face, muted colors

clips.title: Das Ende
clips.prompt: The girl slowly turns to the wall, now two shadows on the wallpaper, a tall one and a small one shaped like her brother, the small shadow cries and reaches out to her, the tall shadow turns its head towards the camera, smash to black

edit_notes: Clips in Reihenfolge 1–8 schneiden, harte Schnitte außer 6→7 (Schwarzblende)
